metricDefinitions.definition: 2026 cumulative ballots through day d divided by selected historical year cumulative ballots through day d, multiplied by 100.

metricDefinitions.label: 2024 presidential benchmark
metricDefinitions.definition: For the same first 16 early-voting days: 2026 accepted ballot count divided by 2024 accepted ballot count, times 100; separately for Wake County and campus sites, for all ages and ages 18–24. evidenceFlow.detail: scripts/build_early_voting_comparison.py --cutoff-date 2026-10-30; exact site mapping; ACCEPTED early-voting records only. scripts/validate_early_voting_comparison.py reconciles days, scopes and demographics. scripts/audit_campus_figures.py independently recounts campus records and checks source archive/member hashes.

metricDefinitions.label: College-age proxy
metricDefinitions.definition: Source age field 18–24 inclusive. The 18–22 alternative is a sensitivity check; neither is a student enrollment flag.

metricDefinitions.label: Campus site
metricDefinitions.definition: TA - NCSU TALLEY STUDENT CENTER in 2022 and 2024; NCSU WESTERN BLVD BUSINESS SERVICES in 2026.

metricDefinitions.label: Matched-day index
metricDefinitions.definition: 2026 cumulative ballots through day d divided by selected historical year cumulative ballots through day d, multiplied by 100.

metricDefinitions.label: Individual-age share
metricDefinitions.definition: Accepted ballots of the given age divided by all ages at that same year’s campus site, times 100.

metricDefinitions.label: Age-group ballot shares
metricDefinitions.definition: Talley Student Union in selected baseline year (2022 by default, also 2024) compared with Western Boulevard Business Services in 2026. First 16 early-voting days in each year. Share = age-group accepted ballots / all accepted ballots at that site in that year * 100. The single share column displays Talley share followed by Western Boulevard share; subordinate counts preserve the underlying ballots. Difference = 2026 share minus baseline share, in percentage points, calculated before rounding. Age order is fixed; ages 18-24 are highlighted. This measures the composition of site users, not countywide share, registered-voter turnout, or a causal effect of the move. 2022 and 2026 are midterms; 2024 is presidential. Each displayed share includes the visible numerator, denominator, and multiplication by 100. The all-site-ballots row is the denominator and sums each mutually exclusive age group.

metricDefinitions.label: Voter-profile ballot shares
metricDefinitions.definition: Source party registration, gender, race, and ethnicity are selectable, separate exhaustive breakdowns of accepted campus-site ballots for the same selected historical baseline and 2026. Share = category ballots / all accepted ballots at that site in that year * 100; difference is 2026 share minus baseline share in percentage points before rounding. Party registration groups DEM, REP, UNA separately and sums all remaining parties into Other registered parties. All recorded unknown or undesignated categories remain included. A category absent in one year is zero after its full dimension reconciles to that year site total. No reviewed source rows change. These characteristics do not identify candidate choice, student enrollment, or the causal effect of the polling-site move.
